sources.label: Morphe patches
sources.author: SailHighSea
patch_list: Removes the "rate this app" popup and the "upgrade to Pro" screen shown on start.
Replaces cloud sync with a local backup. The Sync button opens the backup screen the first time. After a backup file has been chosen, Sync overwrites that file automatically.
Removes banner, interstitial and app open ads, and the "get Pro" ad banners.
